description.narrative: Insatsen syftar till en förstudie om förutsättningarna för ett program inom kvalitetsinfrastruktur i Nordmakedonien
The contribution will result in a pre-study about the preconditions for a program on qualityinfrastructure in North Macedonia.

Syftet är att genomföra en förstudie inför ett eventuellt program i syfte att förbättra kvalitetsinfrastrukturen i Nordmakedonien. Förstudien kommer att resultera i en narrativ ansökan och budget för en designfas om det bedöms finnas goda förutsättingar för ett program.

The pre-study was carried out, including virtual preparatory meetings, consultations with international actors, and a field visit to Skopje in April. During the visit, the delegation met with key institutions involved in North Macedonias quality infrastructure system. These included the Ministry of Economy and Labour, the Ministry of Energy, Mining and Mineral Resources, the European Union Delegation in Skopje, the Institute for Standardization (ISRSM), the national Accreditation Body (IARNM), the Bureau of Metrology (BoM), the Economic Chamber of North Macedonia, and the German development agency GIZ.
The interest of Swedish Private Sector was looked into in different ways during the pre-study. Swedac and SIS had online meeting with Business Sweden in order to understand their analysis of the needs of Swedish companies active in North Macedonia. Additionally, consultation were held in Skopje, with Swedish companies operating in the country to better understand the needs of the business sector in relation to quality infrastructure (QI). One issue raised by Swedish companies were a need for the Macedonian QI actors to clarify the processes involved when companies make use of QI services in the country. This in order to improve transparency and make it easier for companies to plan. Prior to the field visit, Swedac and SIS held a preparatory meeting with the Directorate-General for Internal Market, Industry, Entrepreneurship and SMEs (DG GROW) to discuss the European Commissions view on North Macedonias alignment with the EU internal market framework.
The pre-study confirmed that Swedac and SIS's expertise is aligned with the needs expressed by the North Macedonian actors. An unexpected result was the Ministry of Economy and Labours interest in receiving support to initiate an Agreement on Conformity Assessment and Acceptance of Industrial Products (ACAA) with the EU, this priority was also confirmed by the Ministry of European Affairs.
The findings of the pre-study point to a clear and expressed interest from several of the Macedonian counterparts in receiving structured and long-term support to further strengthen their QI institutions and help them align with EU requirements. Several institutions, including the Ministry of Economy and Labour, the accreditation body (IARNM) and the Standardization body (ISRSM), signaled reform ambition and welcomed continued cooperation. The local ownership by the MInistry of Economy and Labour was emphasized in a letter to the Embassy in June. An application for a design phase was submitted in June 2025.
